tooltip.create_maglev.electric_bogey: Needs stored New Age power from a nearby substation; runs on standard Create track.
tooltip.create_maglev.bullet_bogey: Powered traction bogey. Reinforced track permits its higher speed; ordinary track limits it.
tooltip.create_maglev.maglev_bogey: Needs nearby substation power and a dedicated maglev guideway; levitation falls with power.
tooltip.create_maglev.reinforced_track: Steel-reinforced standard track; compatible with stock and powered bogeys.
tooltip.create_maglev.maglev_track: Dedicated guideway for maglev bogeys; ordinary bogeys cannot run on it.
tooltip.create_maglev.traction_substatio: Stores New Age energy for powered trains. Connect a New Age generator with cables and charge it before use.
tooltip.create_maglev.steel_ingot: Mix iron with coal in a heated Create mixer to make structural steel.
tooltip.create_maglev.steel_sheet: Press a steel ingot into sheet for bogey frames and guideway rails.
tooltip.create_maglev.wound_coil: Assemble copper wire around a shaft with deployers and the press.
tooltip.create_maglev.traction_motor: A finished electric motor assembled with a wound coil and laminated magnetic core.
tooltip.create_maglev.control_unit: Regulates powered bogeys. Bullet and maglev tiers consume more energy.
tooltip.create_maglev.levitation_module: Magnetically energized assembly used to upgrade bullet traction into maglev.
tooltip.create_maglev.unenergized_levita: A complete magnet-and-coil assembly. Energize it with 4096 energy in a New Age energiser.
message.create_maglev.no_power: No traction power. Connect or charge an enabled substation within 64 blocks.
message.create_maglev.incompatible_track: This bogey is incompatible with the current track material.
